title: Export litellm module in lib.rs
description: Add #[cfg(feature = "litellm")] pub mod litellm; to crates/llms/src/lib.rs to conditionally export the module.

title: Wire up LiteLLM in construct_model
description: Add ModelSource::LiteLLM match arm in crates/runtime/src/model/chat.rs construct_model() function. Create litellm() helper function similar to xai() that extracts params and constructs the LiteLLM provider.

title: Add litellm feature to spiced binary
description: Add litellm feature to bin/spiced/Cargo.toml features section. Wire it through runtime and llms crates.

title: Implement Chat trait for LiteLLM
description: Implement async_trait Chat for LiteLLM struct. Use litellm_rs::completion() for chat_request() and litellm_rs::completion_stream() for chat_stream(). Convert between async_openai types and litellm_rs types.

title: Add litellm-rs optional dependency
description: Add litellm-rs = { version = "0.1", optional = true } to crates/llms/Cargo.toml. Add 'litellm' feature flag that enables the dependency.

title: Add LiteLLM integration tests
description: Create integration tests for litellm provider. Add test spicepod in test/spicepods/litellm/ directory. Test basic chat completion and streaming.

title: Document LiteLLM provider usage
description: Update documentation with litellm provider configuration examples. Show how to use litellm:anthropic/claude-3, litellm:gpt-4, etc. in spicepod.yaml.

title: Add ListModels support for LiteLLM
description: Create crates/llms/src/litellm/list_models.rs implementing the ListModels trait. Return available models from the configured LiteLLM provider.

title: Add LiteLLM to ModelSource enum
description: Add LiteLLM variant to ModelSource enum in crates/spicepod/src/component/model.rs. Update TryFrom<&str> and Display impls to handle 'litellm' prefix.

title: Create litellm module structure
description: Create crates/llms/src/litellm/mod.rs with LiteLLM struct. The struct should hold model name, API configuration, and rate controller.
